title: Credential written to external storage (kotlin)
description: kotlin code writes through an external-storage path (context.getExternalFilesDir). Files there are readable by other applications with storage permission and are included in device backups, so a token or PIN written this way leaves the app sandbox. This lexical rule flags the path use; the reviewer confirms what is written.
remediation: Keep credentials in the platform keystore or in app-private storage, for example EncryptedSharedPreferences or the Keystore, and never in a directory other apps can read.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags the external path regardless of the file's contents.
